stance: supports CC and BP; qualifies MF
claim_tested: knh4 supports cell-surface beta-glucan and is GPI-anchored
key_finding: SPBC1E8.05 found in a high-copy suppressor screen of och1-delta; disruptant viable and beta-glucanase sensitive; authors conclude the product non-enzymatically supports beta-glucan on the cell surface
context: S. pombe, growth and enzyme-sensitivity assay
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. Phenotype is indirect, no biochemistry on purified protein, GPI anchoring stated not shown by MS

claim_tested: Knh4 is a cell-surface GPI-anchored protein
key_finding: Neural-network GPI prediction underpins PomBase GO:0009986 cell surface (TAS) and MOD:00818 GPI anchor (ISS)
confidence_and_limitations: Low-medium. Prediction-level, no direct imaging of Knh4

claim_tested: Kre9/Knh1 family acts in beta-1,6-glucan synthesis
key_finding: S. cerevisiae Kre9 is a 30 kDa secretory-pathway protein, kre9-delta loses >80% of wall (1->6)-beta-glucan, Kre9p recovered from culture medium as a 55-60 kDa O-glycoprotein
context: S. cerevisiae biochemistry and wall fractionation
confidence_and_limitations: High for S. cerevisiae. Transfer limited by 30.2% domain identity; secreted, not GPI-anchored

claim_tested: Knh1 is a secreted O-glycoprotein redundant with Kre9
key_finding: Knh1p, like Kre9p, is found in the extracellular medium as a 45-61 kDa O-glycoprotein
confidence_and_limitations: High for S. cerevisiae. Reinforces that the family is secreted in budding yeast

claim_tested: The beta-1,6-glucan substrate exists in fission yeast
key_finding: S. pombe wall contains a major branched beta-1,3-glucan, a minor linear beta-1,3-glucan and a minor branched beta-1,6-glucan, plus a major alpha-1,3-glucan
confidence_and_limitations: High for composition. Says nothing about knh4

claim_tested: Beta-glucan is a resolvable regulated pool in the S. pombe wall
key_finding: ssNMR of intact cells shows a two-fold rise in beta-glucan when alpha-1,3-glucan assembly fails

claim_tested: The conserved Kre9/Knh1 domain adopts a CBM-like beta-sandwich
key_finding: 538 of 870 cath50 hits are CATH 2.60.40.10 immunoglobulin-like beta-sandwich; every prob=1.000 pdb100 hit is an Ig-superfamily structure; 0 CBM, 0 transglycosylase, 0 glycosyltransferase among 934 pdb100 hits
context: AlphaFold AF-O42970-F1, Foldseek web API vs pdb100/cath50/afdb50
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high. Fold call is reliable; Ig and CBM beta-sandwiches are topologically related so this bounds similarity rather than excluding sugar binding outright

claim_tested: Knh4 resembles a real fungal glucan-binding module
key_finding: Gas2 CBM43/X8 (400-489) retrieves 13 Gas/GH72/CBM43 structures among 19 pdb100 hits and 0 Ig hits; O42970 is absent from its 223 afdb50 hits; no Gas/GH72/CBM43 appears among Knh4's 934 pdb100 hits
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high. Control behaves as expected so the negative result is not a parameter artefact

citation: This work: SASA + conservation over 471 homologs
claim_tested: An exposed conserved aromatic surface binds beta-glucan
key_finding: The four invariant aromatics Y90 (0.953), W40 (0.898), F106 (0.877), W78 (0.806) are buried at RSA 0.004-0.048; the only exposed conserved tyrosines Y76 and Y102 lie 17.1 A apart; buried residues are more conserved than exposed ones, 0.441 vs 0.200, U=889, p=4.7e-3
context: AlphaFold model, Shrake-Rupley SASA, Foldseek-derived alignment, median depth 468 per column
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. Conservation comes from structure-based alignments not a curated MSA; a polar or shallow site would escape an aromatic-platform test

claim_tested: Knh4 carries a glycoside hydrolase catalytic acid/base pair
key_finding: All 10 Asp/Glu in the domain are at most 48.5% conserved; 4 pairs fall in a GH-compatible distance window but in every one both partners are solvent-exposed and poorly conserved, so none lines a pocket
context: AlphaFold model, Asp CG / Glu CD pairwise distances
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high. Consistent with the published non-enzymatic conclusion; AlphaFold rotamers add uncertainty

claim_tested: What a genuine fungal beta-glucan site looks like
key_finding: Gas2p bound to laminaripentaose has 29 residues within 4.0 A of the ligand, all in the catalytic (beta/alpha)8 domain; Knh4's domain surface has no comparable conserved polar cluster
confidence_and_limitations: High for the control itself. Different enzyme class so it is a reference point, not a direct comparison

claim_tested: Knh4 can inherit S. cerevisiae KRE9 function
key_finding: All 15 pairwise domain identities lie between 17.6% and 41.8%; knh4 vs Knh1 37.3%, vs Kre9 30.2%, vs its own S. pombe paralogs 21.5% mean; the top pair is Kre9-Knh1 at 41.8%
context: Global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1, PF10342 boundaries from InterPro
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high. Pairwise identity is not a phylogeny; matches the PomBase statement of no apparent S. cerevisiae ortholog

key_finding: Characterisation status conserved unknown; no MF and no BP annotation; only CC is GO:0009986 cell surface (TAS); FYPO:0001190 sensitive to cell wall-degrading enzymes for knh4-delta; no apparent S. cerevisiae ortholog
confidence_and_limitations: Database-level. Reflects curator caution rather than new evidence
